findings.claim: Outbox publishing stalled for ~80s while commits continued at ~3.2/s, then resumed at ~8/s to catch up.
findings.reason: Publication buckets show 7 consecutive zeros and then 80/bucket, against steady arrivals of ~32/bucket.

findings.claim: The stall plausibly explains late notifications, since events committed during it were published late.
findings.reason: A publish gap with 67 more arrivals than publications matches delayed delivery, but customer-facing delay was not measured directly.

findings.claim: The cause of the stall (consumer, DB blocking, pool exhaustion or poller) is unknown; delivery logs and timings were empty.
